name: splax_duo_1
prompt:
Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts thumbnail in the style of a bold Japanese game-news magazine cover. ONE single continuous illustration filling the whole canvas edge to edge (no panels, no frames, no collage, no blurred edges); every area has a role, no empty space. LAYOUT (percent from the top): the title block sits in the upper half, from 7% to 52%, three tiers with strong size contrast: tier 1 = a medium white word with a thick navy outline; tier 2 = the biggest, heaviest words, slightly tilted, with a thick dark outline and a deep 3D extrusion shadow, spanning at least 90% of the image width (edge to edge inside the safe margins); its color must stand out strongly from the background hue: on an orange/yellow background use WHITE letters with a very thick navy or black outline (never yellow on orange), yellow letters only on dark navy/blue/purple backgrounds; tier 3 = a small white text on a colored ribbon or banner. There is NO person and NO character in this image: the lower half (from 50% down to the bottom edge) is filled by the big topic objects described below, drawn large and slightly right of center, overlapping the bottom of the title so the picture and the letters feel like one piece. Clean bold 2D anime/cartoon style, vivid saturated colors, strong contrast, strong rim light. SAFE MARGINS: every letter of every text (all tiers and badges) must stay at least 7% of the image height away from the top and bottom edges (the phone app cuts about 3% off the top and bottom; the top line of text must start no higher than 7% from the top) and at least 3% of the width away from the left and right edges; keep the top-right corner (right 14%, top 12%) free of text because a menu button covers it there. Use the full width for the title: tiers 1 and 2 should run almost edge to edge. The background and objects still extend to all edges. All Japanese text perfectly spelled exactly as given, no other text, no numbers other than those in the given text, no real brand logos, no watermark. Do NOT draw any character, mascot, squid, octopus, weapon or logo from any existing video game; the game controllers are generic original designs with no brand marks. No tiny decorative patterns or sparkles.
Colors: dark navy with glowing cyan and violet neon. Scene: two big generic game controllers, one bright yellow and one blue-violet, lean toward each other and touch like a fist bump, joined by a thick glowing chain link; a huge glowing neon letter-X shape made of two crossing light beams stands behind them; big splashes of yellow paint and blue-violet paint fly out from the two sides. Title: tier 1 'スプラ3 Xマッチ'; tier 2 'フレンドと2人で' (yellow); tier 3 ribbon (orange) '冬から試験導入'.
